outcome: delivery within 24 hours of induction of labour
cohort: 154 women aged 18-40 years, at term (>=37 weeks gestational age) with premature rupture of membranes.
finding: Immediate induction of labour resulted in a significantly higher rate of delivery within 24 hours (88.31%) compared to delayed induction (70.13%) in term women with pre-labour rupture of membranes.
